notes.title: 03/12/2023 update log
notes.content:
1. Add some achievements and characters
2. Add appreciation opening rewards
3. Stranger adds the function of dropping troops
4. Now can also buy hints when traveling through thousands of mountains
5. The opening rewards can be viewed in Achievements and Appreciation
6. Added lock for items
7. Hero mode will drop equipment if you don’t accept it
8. Fix some bugs

notes.title: 1.0.0(8) Updated the treasure map feature
notes.content:
1.0.0 (8)
Updated the treasure map feature
You can view the walkthrough
You can also give feedback

notes.title: Added entertainment mode - Survival | Elite | Growth
notes.content:
This version is basically close to the pattern of the mobile version.
Five entertainment modes are added, I hope players can like it.
The five entertainment modes are: Survival | Elite | Growth | Hero | Chaos

notes.title: Add mode - Chaos mode
notes.content:
Introduction to Chaos Mode:
[olist]
[*] Unlock conditions: At least two people have appreciation value, and the game completion rate reaches 5%.
[*] Unrecruitable mode.
[*] The mode of wearing a magic weapon if you don't pay attention.
[*] Tip: Easy, Hard, Survival, Elite mode earning can increase the appreciation value.
[*] The items, money, and troops carried by the characters in each game are random.
[/olist]
Other modes will be added in the future.
